pending_interview.category: System design (ML/AI-specific) — RAG at scale, eval pipeline design, recommendation systems, agent platforms, feature store design
pending_interview.question: You are designing a real-time recommendation system for a large e-commerce platform with 200 million users and a catalog of 50 million products. The system must serve personalized product recommendations with low latency (under 100 milliseconds) at the point of purchase. Walk through your architecture: how do you generate, store, and serve recommendations at this scale? Where does a feature store fit in, what goes in it, and how do you keep features fresh? How would you design the offline training pipeline alongside the online serving path, and what are the main failure modes you need to plan for?
